{{Top|leg}}
The '''MedNet''' was a public forum accessible by doctors and physicians during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Kornell Divini]] accessed it to inquire about [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] from a cell biologist, a forbidden subject which was banned by the Emperor himself. The action tripped a warning flag which alerted Imperial overseers to notify [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
